newsitem.title: USA: H&R Block opens in United Kingdom market.
newsitem.headline: H&R Block opens in United Kingdom market.

text.p: H&R Block Inc, the world's largest tax preparation firm, said Wednesday it will enter the United Kingdom, the first new country the company has entered in about 25 years.

H&R Block said its subsidiary, H&R Block U.K. Ltd., has purchased for cash The Tax Team Limited, a Horsham-based firm with 12 offices in the United Kingdom. Eleven of the offices are franchised, although additional offices soon to open will be primarily company-owned. Terms were withheld.
Negotiations between the two companies began several months ago after announcements last year that the United Kingdom was switching to a self assessment taxation system.
"This presented possible opportunities for H&R Block, but we wanted to carefully assess the market before taking any actions," said Ozzie Wenich, president of H&R Block International, in a statement.
The Tax Team will retain its name and continue to be led by managing director Gerry Hart. It will immediately begin to offer financial planning and accounting services.
Tax preparation fees will start at 75 stg.
H&R Block said it plans to open additional offices in the U.K and is studying entry into other international markets.
